legacy_migration.trigger: A locked project-original script places at least three people in a moving compact vehicle and requires outside changes to redirect attention across multiple seat zones; picture alone does not prove roles, relationships, attack attribution or reaction causes.
legacy_migration.directing_decision: Establish seat/aperture geometry first, then let a mobile observer transfer among occupant zones and exterior apertures while returning to vehicle pillars, seats, wheel or door as local orientation anchors.
legacy_migration.coverage: Vehicle/cabin master → front/rear occupant handoff → windshield exterior state → side aperture receiver/group → cabin state return → door/road threshold if script-required.
legacy_migration.blocking: Assign stable front-left/front-right/rear-left/rear-center/rear-right zones and visible apertures; keep one vehicle-frame edge or seat relation readable during each handoff; do not infer who drives, commands or protects from position alone.
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Spend enough early time for the seat map to register; accelerate attention transfers only when a script-verified outside state changes; use gross posture/body changes at low-resolution or high-motion moments instead of micro-expression beats.
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK for this source. Any dialogue, engine/tyre cue, impact, gunfire, alarm, crowd, music, off-screen cue or sound-led edit/performance timing must be rebuilt from verified project-original script and sound evidence.
legacy_migration.applicability: Moving-car dialogue, family/group travel, evacuation, surveillance or pursuit where a locked script requires simultaneous occupant and exterior state awareness.
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Do not use when one occupant alone owns the scene, geography should remain deliberately disorienting, windows must reveal nothing, or safe production/generation cannot preserve a moving vehicle and multiple bodies.
legacy_migration.failure_mode: Seat zones become unreadable; camera motion competes with the script beat; every occupant changes together; vehicle apertures reverse unpredictably; low-resolution faces are overinterpreted; a long-path imitation replaces project-specific logic.
legacy_migration.counterexample: COUNTEREXAMPLE UNKNOWN: same-trigger contrary source pending. Different-trigger boundary inside this source: the final road hold no longer needs multi-seat handoffs once the vehicle has departed the near frame.
legacy_migration.unknown: Roles, relationship, driver/passenger authority, dialogue, outside-event cause, exact gaze targets, vehicle speed/path, sound, rig/stitch method, audience response and same-trigger contrary source.
legacy_migration.ai_risk: CRITICAL: camera=repeatable multi-zone path inside a moving constrained space; performance=asynchronous gross actions across several bodies; continuity=seat zones, apertures, vehicle direction and visible state tokens.
